name: 36693 · Mobile, AL
findings: ZIP 36693 (Mobile) has 51 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 13 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 36693 (Mobile) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 36693 (Mobile) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 46% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.
